events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969, bringing together half a million people for '3 Days of Peace & Music'.

angles.name: Woodstock Legacy
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, a field in upstate New York became the epicentre of a cultural revolution. Remembering Woodstock, the festival that defined a generation.

events.title: Elvis Presley Anniversary
events.blurb: This day marks the anniversary of the passing of the 'King of Rock and Roll', Elvis Presley, in 1977.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: On this day, we remember the one and only Elvis Presley. His music and legend continue to rock the world.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Anniversary
events.blurb: The music world remembers guitar legend Jimi Hendrix, who passed away on this day in 1970.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us too soon on this day in 1970. His guitar still screams.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since The Beatles gave us the masterpiece that is 'Abbey Road'. Still sounds as fresh as ever.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Happy 75th Birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking and still as cool as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday LG
angles.copy: Our kid Liam Gallagher is 54 today! Hope he's having it large. As you were.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music, on this day in 2001.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, the original iPod dropped and changed how we listen to music forever. How many songs did you cram onto yours?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day celebrates the premiere of the first 007 film, Dr. No, on this day in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Celebrating over six decades of 007, from the iconic gadgets to those legendary theme tunes.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: John Lennon Tribute
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we're remembering the incomparable John Lennon. Imagine all the music...

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy icon, John Cleese! No silly walks required, just pure genius.

events.title: Freddie Mercury Anniversary
events.blurb: Remembering the iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury, who passed away on this day in 1991.

angles.name: Freddie Forever
angles.copy: Thirty-five years since we lost the unforgettable Freddie Mercury. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. The show must go on.
